question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, why did the Langmuir model describe BC-20's CO2 isotherm better than the Freundlich model?
rendered: The Langmuir model was not said to describe BC-20's CO2 isotherm better than the Freundlich model. In fact, the Freundlich model provided a better statistical description of the CO2 adsorption isotherms than the Langmuir model, as mentioned in the excerpt on page 13: "Freundlich fitting provides a better statistical description than Langmuir fitting, although neither model fully represents BC-10."
